stem.text: A vibrating tuning fork is held over a measuring cylinder, as shown.

stem.alt: Measuring cylinder with a tuning fork held over its top; a container labelled water is at the upper left and the tuning fork is labelled at the right.

stem.text: Water is then gradually poured into the measuring cylinder. A much louder sound is first heard when the water level is $2.9\,\text{cm}$ above the base of the measuring cylinder. A second much louder sound is heard when the water level reaches a height of $67.3\,\text{cm}$ above the base.
The speed of sound in air is $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the tuning fork?
